name: 🤖 Daily job automation - BA/JobSpy + OpenCode + Notion

assignments.name: searchConfig
assignments.value: {"keywords": "QA Engineer OR Test Automation OR Testingenieur OR Quality Engineer OR HiL OR CI/CD OR Embedded OR DevOps OR Software Test", "hours_old": 24, "max_total": 30, "sites": ["linkedin", "indeed"], "locations": [["Munich, Germany", 8], ["Bavaria, Germany", 3]], "timeout_s": 90, "scraper_timeout_ms": 330000, "ba": {"enabled": true, "terms": ["Testautomatisierung", "Test Engineer", "QA Engineer", "Software Test", "HiL", "Embedded Software", "DevOps Engineer"], "location": "München", "radius_km": 30, "per_term": 12, "limit": 22, "detail_limit": 22}}

nodes.name: 🌐 Scrape Jobs (BA + LinkedIn/Indeed)
nodes.notes: POSTs the search config to the local scraper bridge (scraper_server.js -> scrape_jobs.py). Sources: Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit Jobsuche v6 (primary) + LinkedIn/Indeed via JobSpy.

nodes.name: 📋 Parse Job List
nodes.notes: Internship/student filter + defence/military filter (company blocklist + text signals) + dedupe; emits {jobs, stats}.

nodes.name: 📊 Parse Score Result
nodes.notes: Parses the OpenCode Go response; job identity comes from the upstream item, and the Match Reason is assembled as two blocks (matches / considerations), one bullet per line.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'deepseek-v4-flash', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are a recruitment matching expert. Reply with strict JSON only - no extra text." }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt } ], temperature: 0.3, max_tokens: 3000, stream: false } }}

nodes.name: 🧠 OpenCode DeepSeek Scoring
nodes.notes: opencode.ai/zen/go/v1 (OpenCode Go subscription) — deepseek-v4-flash. Requires x-opencode-session header + browser UA, otherwise 400/403.

nodes.name: 📥 Read Existing Notion Jobs
nodes.notes: Reads existing recommendations so already-seen postings are skipped (fail-open: if Notion is down, the run continues).

nodes.name: 🔁 Drop Already Seen
nodes.notes: Dedupe against the Notion database (by link + jobId) so a job is only ever recommended once.

nodes.name: 🛡️ CV Valid?
nodes.notes: Abort loudly instead of scoring every job against a broken CV.

nodes.name: ❌ Scrape Failed
nodes.notes: Error output of the scraper node (bridge down / scrape failed). Checked by the error workflow + Telegram.

nodes.name: 📣 Telegram Run Summary
nodes.notes: Run summary; also the smoke signal that the daily automation actually ran.

parameters.text: ⚠️ Job automation aborted: cv/CV.pdf could not be read. Check that the file exists.

nodes.name: 📵 Telegram: CV Missing
nodes.notes: Run summary; also the smoke signal that the daily automation actually ran.

parameters.content:
## 1. Read the CV
pdf -> text -> validity check (aborts loudly if unreadable)

## 2. Scrape jobs
Config lives in `🔍 Search Config` (single source of truth) -> local bridge on localhost:3456
Primary: Bundesagentur für Arbeit Jobsuche v6 (free, stable)
Secondary: JobSpy -> LinkedIn / Indeed (rate limited)

## 3. Filter + dedupe
internships/students -> defence/military (company blocklist + text signals) -> already in Notion

## 4. Score (OpenCode Go -> DeepSeek V4 Flash)
one call per job, 3 retries; anything scoring < 6 is dropped

## 5. Write to Notion + summary
Top 10, tiers at 7.5 / 6; Telegram run summary at the end

parameters.text: ={{ '⚠️ Job automation: scrape failed\n' + ($json.error?.message || $json.message || 'unknown error') + '\nCheck that the local scraper bridge (localhost:3456) is running.' }}

nodes.name: 📣 Telegram: Scrape failed
nodes.notes: Alerts when the scraper node fails (bridge down, scrape error) instead of ending the run silently.

description: Scrapes Bundesagentur/JobSpy postings daily, filters internships and defence/military jobs, dedupes against Notion, scores them with DeepSeek V4 Flash on OpenCode Go, then writes the Top 10 to Notion and posts a Telegram summary.
